title: 可重現軟體建置
summary: 以確定輸入、位元重現與差異診斷連結 16 個技術單元，新增 32 步原理、架構、假想算例、實驗設計與失效驗證。
summaryEn: Sixteen technical units connect defined inputs, byte reproducibility and difference diagnosis through 32 new tasks covering principles, architecture, assumed calculations, experiment design and failure validation.
scope: 公開原理的雙語工程教育；工作臺是概念模擬，不是特定廠商產品的完整模擬器。數值為自行設定的教學假設。實驗僅限離線模型、自己的隔離環境或明確授權的測試資料；不掃描或改動真實第三方系統，未測平臺保留未決。
scopeEn: Bilingual engineering education from public principles; the workbench is a conceptual simulation, not a complete simulator of any vendor product. Inputs are original teaching assumptions. Experiments use offline models, owned isolated environments or explicitly authorized test data, never scan/modify third-party systems and leave untested platforms unresolved.

stages.title: 建置輸入契約
stages.description: 四個技術單元以原理／架構與實驗／驗證兩步完成「建置輸入契約」；每步獨立保存進度與知識測驗。
stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop build-input contracts through separate principle/architecture and experiment/validation tasks with saved progress and knowledge checks.

steps.title: 重現定義：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「重現定義」建立可檢查的架構、原理與驗證依據。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish reviewable architecture, principles and evidence for reproduction definition.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「重現定義」的資料、控制與時間關係。相同程式行為不等於相同位元。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「比較語義與位元驗收。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for reproduction definition. Equivalent behavior differs from byte identity. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Compare semantic and byte acceptance. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：兩包可重現就可證明原始碼無惡意。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Reproducible bundles prove the source is benign. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「重現定義」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「相同程式行為不等於相同位元。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit reproduction definition two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.

knowledge.title: 重現定義的原理與邊界
knowledge.text: 相同程式行為不等於相同位元。
knowledge.textEn: Equivalent behavior differs from byte identity.

knowledge.title: 重現定義的驗證設計
knowledge.text: 比較語義與位元驗收。 保留基準與擾動的完整輸入／輸出，以語義、容量或時間條件檢查，並明列假想模型未涵蓋的現實因素。
knowledge.textEn: Compare semantic and byte acceptance. Retain complete inputs/outputs for baseline and perturbation, check semantic/capacity/timing criteria and state real-world factors omitted from the hypothetical model.

knowledge.title: 本課原創量化算例
knowledge.text: ZIP 基本 DOS 時間欄位只有 2 s 精度：同分鐘 0 s 與 1 s 可能編碼相同，0 s 與 2 s 才改變該欄位；額外時間欄位可有不同精度。必須比較實際編碼的 metadata，不能宣稱邏輯時間差 1 s 必然改變包摘要。固定檔案清單、順序、工具版本與正規化時間後比較位元。128 MiB 在假設 256 MiB/s 下雜湊約 0.5 s。
knowledge.textEn: ZIP basic DOS time fields have 2 s precision: seconds 0 and 1 in one minute may encode identically, whereas 0 and 2 change that field; extra timestamp fields may use other precision. Compare encoded metadata rather than claiming every logical 1 s change alters the archive digest. Match manifests, order, tool versions and normalized times for byte comparison. Hashing 128 MiB at assumed 256 MiB/s takes 0.5 s.

quiz.question: 本步審查「重現定義」與整體「可重現軟體建置」時，哪項陳述或驗證有依據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing reproduction definition within reproducible software builds, which statement or check is supported?
options: 相同程式行為不等於相同位元。
兩包可重現就可證明原始碼無惡意。
相同原始碼即可忽略工具鏈和時間差異。
optionsEn: Equivalent behavior differs from byte identity.
Reproducible bundles prove the source is benign.
Identical source makes toolchain/time differences irrelevant.
quiz.explanation: 相同程式行為不等於相同位元。 比較語義與位元驗收。 其餘選項混淆不同架構或證據的適用邊界。
quiz.explanationEn: Equivalent behavior differs from byte identity. Compare semantic and byte acceptance. The alternatives confuse architectural or evidence boundaries.

steps.title: 重現定義：實驗與驗證
steps.objective: 用「比較語義與位元驗收。」檢查「重現定義」的假設、結果及失效邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Validate assumptions, outcomes and failure boundaries for reproduction definition using the specified experiment.
steps.instruction: 重播師傅對「重現定義」的示範，在自己的隔離模型或試算表執行：比較語義與位元驗收。 核對「相同程式行為不等於相同位元。」是否成立；保留輸入、預期、實際結果與差異。至少提出兩個競爭原因，選擇一項能區分它們的新增觀察。依事前定義的語義、容量或延遲條件判斷通過／保留，未執行的真實平臺項目不得標為實測。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the mentor for reproduction definition and execute in your own isolated model or worksheet: Compare semantic and byte acceptance. Check the principle: Equivalent behavior differs from byte identity. Preserve input, expected output, observed output and differences. Propose two competing causes and a discriminating observation. Apply predefined semantic, capacity or latency criteria and mark untested real-platform claims unresolved.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：兩包可重現就可證明原始碼無惡意。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Reproducible bundles prove the source is benign. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「重現定義」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「比較語義與位元驗收。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
steps.checkEn: Submit reproduction definition input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.

Identical source makes toolchain/time differences irrelevant.
Match package versions and digests.
quiz.explanation: 版本名稱應繫結不可變內容。 核對套件版本與摘要。 其餘選項混淆不同架構或證據的適用邊界。
quiz.explanationEn: Version labels bind immutable content. Match package versions and digests. The alternatives confuse architectural or evidence boundaries.

steps.title: 建置規格：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「建置規格」建立可檢查的架構、原理與驗證依據。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish reviewable architecture, principles and evidence for build specifications.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「建置規格」的資料、控制與時間關係。環境資訊需足以重建而非只說明 OS。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「建立最小可重現環境表。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for build specifications. Environment records must enable rebuilding, not just name an OS. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Build a minimal reproduction environment table. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
steps.observation: 建立最小可重現環境表。
steps.observationEn: Build a minimal reproduction environment table.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：相同原始碼即可忽略工具鏈和時間差異。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Identical source makes toolchain/time differences irrelevant. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「建置規格」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「環境資訊需足以重建而非只說明 OS。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit build specifications two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.

knowledge.title: 建置規格的原理與邊界
knowledge.text: 環境資訊需足以重建而非只說明 OS。
knowledge.textEn: Environment records must enable rebuilding, not just name an OS.

knowledge.title: 建置規格的驗證設計
knowledge.text: 建立最小可重現環境表。 保留基準與擾動的完整輸入／輸出，以語義、容量或時間條件檢查，並明列假想模型未涵蓋的現實因素。
knowledge.textEn: Build a minimal reproduction environment table. Retain complete inputs/outputs for baseline and perturbation, check semantic/capacity/timing criteria and state real-world factors omitted from the hypothetical model.

quiz.question: 本步審查「建置規格」與整體「可重現軟體建置」時，哪項陳述或驗證有依據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing build specifications within reproducible software builds, which statement or check is supported?
options: 環境資訊需足以重建而非只說明 OS。
兩包可重現就可證明原始碼無惡意。
相同原始碼即可忽略工具鏈和時間差異。
optionsEn: Environment records must enable rebuilding, not just name an OS.
Reproducible bundles prove the source is benign.

quiz.explanationEn: Environment records must enable rebuilding, not just name an OS. Build a minimal reproduction environment table. The alternatives confuse architectural or evidence boundaries.

steps.title: 建置規格：實驗與驗證
steps.objective: 用「建立最小可重現環境表。」檢查「建置規格」的假設、結果及失效邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Validate assumptions, outcomes and failure boundaries for build specifications using the specified experiment.
steps.instruction: 重播師傅對「建置規格」的示範，在自己的隔離模型或試算表執行：建立最小可重現環境表。 核對「環境資訊需足以重建而非只說明 OS。」是否成立；保留輸入、預期、實際結果與差異。至少提出兩個競爭原因，選擇一項能區分它們的新增觀察。依事前定義的語義、容量或延遲條件判斷通過／保留，未執行的真實平臺項目不得標為實測。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the mentor for build specifications and execute in your own isolated model or worksheet: Build a minimal reproduction environment table. Check the principle: Environment records must enable rebuilding, not just name an OS. Preserve input, expected output, observed output and differences. Propose two competing causes and a discriminating observation. Apply predefined semantic, capacity or latency criteria and mark untested real-platform claims unresolved.
steps.observation: 建立最小可重現環境表。
steps.observationEn: Build a minimal reproduction environment table.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：相同原始碼即可忽略工具鏈和時間差異。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Identical source makes toolchain/time differences irrelevant. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「建置規格」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「建立最小可重現環境表。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
steps.checkEn: Submit build specifications input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.
